native_review.summary: The user successfully requested modification of their bookshelf to a 4 ft version with the same material and color. The agent authenticated the user, located the order, determined the desired glass/white 4 ft variant was unavailable, and then followed the user's instruction to cancel the entire order after obtaining explicit confirmation. The cancellation was processed correctly and the gift card refund was applied. No user errors were found. The agent committed minor policy violations by making multiple tool calls simultaneously and by sending user-facing messages in the same turns as tool calls, but these did not affect the final outcome.

errors.reasoning: The agent made two get_order_details tool calls simultaneously and also sent a user-facing message in the same turn. The policy explicitly states the agent should make at most one tool call at a time and should not respond to the user while making a tool call.
errors.correct_behavior: The agent should have made one tool call at a time, waited for the tool response, and avoided sending a user message in the same turn as a tool call.

errors.reasoning: The agent sent a user-facing message and also made the get_product_details tool call in the same turn. This violates the policy that the agent should not respond to the user and make a tool call at the same time.
errors.correct_behavior: The agent should have either responded to the user first without making the tool call, or made the tool call without including a user-facing message.
